/usr/bin/bash -lc "pkill -f '"'^node /tmp/pomodoro-browser-check/check.cjs$'"' || true
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/tmp/pomodoro-browser-check/check.cjs')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace(\"  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');\", \"  await page.reload();\\n  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');\")
p.write_text(s)
